title: Samurai Jack
description: A great warrior is displaced to the distant future by the evil shape-shifting wizard Aku. The world has become a bleak place under the rule of Aku, segregated into fantastic tribes and ruled by Aku’s evil robot warlords. Jack travels this foreign landscape in search of a time portal that can return him to his home time so he can “undo the future that is Aku!”.

episodes_data.title: Samurai Jack 1x1
episodes_data.description: When Aku is reborn to set forth his reign of terror, the Emperor's son is sent off to learn the ways of the samurai. That boy becomes a man and attempts to slay Aku with a mighty sword, but Aku banishes him to the future.

episodes_data.title: Samurai Jack 1x2
episodes_data.description: The Samurai lands in the future and is named Jack. He is enlisted by a race of dogs to destroy Aku.

episodes_data.title: Samurai Jack 1x3
episodes_data.description: Jack gets weapons and beats back Aku's army of beetles saving the canine race.

episodes_data.title: Samurai Jack 1x4
episodes_data.description: Jack helps free the Woolies from the tyrannical Chritchellites.

episodes_data.title: Samurai Jack 1x5
episodes_data.description: When Jack mistakenly destroys a group of scientists' chance to escape Aku, he and the scientists join forces to try and fix the problem, hopefully returning Jack home as well.

episodes_data.title: Samurai Jack 1x6
episodes_data.description: Aku morphs himself into a woman in order to keep Jack from returning to the past to destroy him.

episodes_data.title: Samurai Jack 1x7
episodes_data.description: Jack must get past three blind archers to reach an all-powerful wishing well.

episodes_data.title: Samurai Jack 1x8
episodes_data.description: Jack meets up with Mad Jack and must battle his darker self.

episodes_data.title: Samurai Jack 1x9
episodes_data.description: Jack has an underwater adventure with a jelly-whale and sea monkeys while hunting for an ancient time portal.

episodes_data.title: Samurai Jack 1x10
episodes_data.description: Jack goes through a cave full of challenges only to find an old warrior longing to reach Valhalla.

episodes_data.title: Samurai Jack 1x11
episodes_data.description: When Jack and a Scotsman meet on a never-ending bridge, they end up shackled together and on the run from bounty hunters.

episodes_data.title: Samurai Jack 1x12
episodes_data.description: Jack hooks up with some Chicago gangsters to try and get close to Aku.

episodes_data.title: Samurai Jack 1x13
episodes_data.description: Aku tells fairy tales to the children to try and win them over to his side instead of Jack's.

episodes_data.title: Samurai Jack 2x1
episodes_data.description: Jack comes upon a monkey-man and agrees to train his tribe in the ways of defending themselves if the monkey-man teaches him how to "jump good".

episodes_data.title: Samurai Jack 2x2
episodes_data.description: Three short stories: Jack vs. the Worm: Jack confronts a two-headed riddling serpent who will grant him his wish if he can answer their questions;  The Metal-Eaters: Jack confronts a family that feed on metal and eat Jack's sword; Jack, the Gargoyle and the Fairy: Jack tries to rescue a wish-granting fairy from a gargoyle so that she may grant his wish to return home.

episodes_data.title: Samurai Jack 2x3
episodes_data.description: Jack is kidnapped and placed in a chain gang of warriors chosen to battle in front of a coliseum audience against the Dome of Doom's Champions.

episodes_data.title: Samurai Jack 2x4
episodes_data.description: The Scotsman needs Jack's help to save his kidnapped wife. But this woman is hardly the distressed damsel the Scotsman makes her out to be.

episodes_data.title: Samurai Jack 2x5
episodes_data.description: Jack goes from destroyed village to another looking for those responsible, only to find the destruction was commissioned by Aku.

episodes_data.title: Samurai Jack 2x6
episodes_data.description: Jack comes upon ruins of a village and realizes it is his home. He then reflects on the past when he was a young boy.

episodes_data.title: Samurai Jack 2x7
episodes_data.description: Jack travels vertically up a mountain with three monks to witness the magic of the mountain only to have the power of the mountain save his very life.

episodes_data.title: Samurai Jack 2x8
episodes_data.description: When a flatulent dragon begins stinking out an entire village. Jack slays the beast and ventures inside it to cure to source of its bellyache.

episodes_data.title: Samurai Jack 2x9
episodes_data.description: Aku hires the best hunters in the galaxy to track down the most elusive of prey - Samurai Jack.

episodes_data.title: Samurai Jack 2x10
episodes_data.description: Aku sends out Demongo, the soul collector, to destroy Jack. Now Jack must fight all the mighty warrior souls that Demongo has collected.

episodes_data.title: Samurai Jack 2x11
episodes_data.description: When Jack has his sword and clothing stolen, he must give chase to a white rabbit who took them while trying to maintain his modesty.

episodes_data.title: Samurai Jack 2x12
episodes_data.description: Jack comes upon a battle where a mere 300 men are fighting a vast, unending army of robots and their evil robotic leader.

episodes_data.title: Samurai Jack 2x13
episodes_data.description: When a band of bikes mow over Jack's sandals, he goes on a hunt for the perfect footwear.

episodes_data.title: Samurai Jack 3x1
episodes_data.description: Jack is turned into a chicken by a cranky wizard. While he tries to fix this, he gets caught by a "handler" and becomes a prize-winning Creature Combat fighter.

episodes_data.title: Samurai Jack 3x2
episodes_data.description: Aku leads Jack to a graveyard where the dead begin to rise. An evil spirit takes over Jack's sword, leading Jack to defend himself against his own weapon. When Aku gets hold of the sword, Jack fears he's finally met his end.

episodes_data.title: Samurai Jack 3x3
episodes_data.description: When a man's daughter is kidnapped by Aku's Children, Jack must infiltrate a rave to stop the musical brainwashing.

episodes_data.title: Samurai Jack 3x4
episodes_data.description: Jack boards a train to his next destination only to be attacked by a couple of arguing bounty hunters.

episodes_data.title: Samurai Jack 3x5
episodes_data.description: Jack must read hieroglyphics, solve riddles and assemble a sacred scarab to call upon Ra for help in fighting evil ancient Egyptian shadow warriors.

episodes_data.title: Samurai Jack 3x6
episodes_data.description: Jack must travel along a water creature, a mountain creature and a flying creature to get to a portal to return home. But once he reaches the portal, it is guarded by an undefeatable warrior who tells him that this portal is not for him.

episodes_data.title: Samurai Jack 3x7
episodes_data.description: An over-friendly creature begins following Jack, messing up Jack's every move along his quest.

episodes_data.title: Samurai Jack 3x8
episodes_data.description: Jack and a Swamp Wizard travel to the four corners of the earth, collecting pieces that are meant to get Jack home. But when Aku reveals himself to be the Swamp Wizard, Jack must battle these pieces which are now being puppeteered by Aku's evil hands.

episodes_data.title: Samurai Jack 3x9
episodes_data.description: When Jack enters a spooky, old mansion and gets locked inside, he catches sight of a figure and sets after it to find out what is going on. As Jack is led further and further in, he discovers that the house and its inhabitants have an evil plan that involves…him.

episodes_data.title: Samurai Jack 3x10
episodes_data.description: Jack falls into a hidden temple sanctuary to find monks trained like him in the style of the Ancient Master. The Ancient Master's Son then tells Jack of a portal to send him home, but in order to use it, his new friends must be sacrificed.

episodes_data.title: Samurai Jack 3x11
episodes_data.description: Jack is carefully making his way through a labyrinth to reach a mysterious box - the problem is, so are two thieves.

episodes_data.title: Samurai Jack 4x1
episodes_data.description: Aku sends a Ninja to destroy Jack who is busily helping a port town in distress.

episodes_data.title: Samurai Jack 4x2
episodes_data.description: Jack enters a village to discover that he is their Chosen One meant to embody the Robo-Samurai and destroy the Mondo-bot that has come to destroy them.

episodes_data.title: Samurai Jack 4x3
episodes_data.description: Jack is approached by a cool Samurai-punk who wants to battle with Jack in order to prove that he is the best.

episodes_data.title: Samurai Jack 4x4
episodes_data.description: When ancient gods try to destroy a powerful evil, they send one piece of the beast hurtling through space. This piece lands on earth, spreading its evil through the land. When it encroaches on an Emperor's empire, he takes it upon himself to destroy the evil, but ends up unleashing the evil that is Aku.

episodes_data.title: Samurai Jack 4x5
episodes_data.description: Jack has lost all memory of who he is and it's up to the Scotsman to put the pieces of the puzzle together to save the samurai.

episodes_data.title: Samurai Jack 4x6
episodes_data.description: When Aku catches a cold and sneezes on Jack, Jack becomes infected with Aku’s badness which begins to take over his entire body.

episodes_data.title: Samurai Jack 4x7
episodes_data.description: When Aku raises the bounty on Jack, the best bounty hunters in the world gather to capture him.

episodes_data.title: Samurai Jack 4x8
episodes_data.description: Jack helps save a Prince and Princess whose ship has been shot down to Earth by Aku.

episodes_data.title: Samurai Jack 4x9
episodes_data.description: Tired of all the bounty hunters and robots failing, Aku fights Jack, mano y mano.

episodes_data.title: Samurai Jack 4x10
episodes_data.description: As Jack goes through fall, winter, spring and summer, he must battle the perils that each season brings.

episodes_data.title: Samurai Jack 4x11
episodes_data.description: Aku forces an old, ace robot assassin out of retirement to eliminate the ultimate mark - Jack.

episodes_data.title: Samurai Jack 4x12
episodes_data.description: Young Jack is brought to Africa for part of his training, but when his tribe is abducted, he must learn how to use their unique sword-like weapon – and fast!

episodes_data.title: Samurai Jack 4x13
episodes_data.description: Jack finds a baby and the two travel together as Jack tries to return the boy to his mother.

episodes_data.title: Samurai Jack 5x1
episodes_data.description: It's been 50 years since we last saw Samurai Jack and time has not been kind to him. Aku has destroyed every time portal and Jack has stopped aging, a side effect of time travel. It seems he is cursed to just roam the land for all eternity. His past haunts him as well as a cult of assasins dedicated to killing him for Aku's glory.

episodes_data.title: Samurai Jack 5x2
episodes_data.description: Jack's will to survive is pushed to its absolute limits after a deadly, unseen foe launches a relentless surprise attack.

episodes_data.title: Samurai Jack 5x3
episodes_data.description: Samurai Jack is gravely injured, but still decides to face one of the deadliest foes he's ever faced, Assassins from the Cult of Aku.

episodes_data.title: Samurai Jack 5x4
episodes_data.description: Samurai Jack partners with a deadly assassin in order to escape a gargantuan creature that has swallowed them whole.

episodes_data.title: Samurai Jack 5x5
episodes_data.description: Samurai Jack fights to save a group of enslaved people from being harvested as the power source for a monstrous Mega-Robot.

episodes_data.title: Samurai Jack 5x6
episodes_data.description: Ashi's search for Samurai Jack helps her to see his effect on the world after encountering numerous people and places where he has changed things for the better

episodes_data.title: Samurai Jack 5x7
episodes_data.description: Jack and Ashi overcome a series of dangerous physical and spiritual tests in order to recover Jack's sword.

episodes_data.title: Samurai Jack 5x8
episodes_data.description: The burgeoning relationship between Jack and Ashi takes a turn after they are hunted by one of the galaxy's deadliest creatures.

episodes_data.title: Samurai Jack 5x9
episodes_data.description: Samurai Jack's worst fear is realized when he faces off against Aku; the demon makes a shocking discovery about Ashi that puts her in grave danger.

episodes_data.title: Samurai Jack 5x10
episodes_data.description: The fate of the entire universe hangs in the balance as Samurai Jack faces Aku.
